paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Data source distribution of combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources within a combined training set. The chart contains ten categories, visually represented by differently colored slices arranged in a roughly descending order by size. The slices are labeled “NQ” (31.3%, blue), “SCIFACT” (0.1%, light green), “ENTFA” (1.8%, green), “FACTCC” (2.6%, orange), “ANLI” (4.6%, red), “FEVER” (16.1%, teal), “MULTINLI” (11.3%, purple), “MULTIFC” (0.5%, pink), “SCITAIL” (1.2%, salmon), and “SNLI” (15.4%, orange).  Percentage labels are provided directly within each slice, and a legend listing each data source and its corresponding percentage is present to the left of the chart. No slices are visually emphasized through techniques like explosion or bolding.
